description: A security vulnerability has been detected in ZKTeco BioTime 9.5.6 Build 20260130.3206. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /base/api/v1.0/systemSettings/db_migrate_setting/ of the component Database Migration Functionality. Such manipulation leads to sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. Upgrading to version 9.5.6 Build 3623 addresses this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised.
